_approach: Basic Channel-style dub techno: an unswung 4/4 kick, a snare/clap that lands on only the third downbeat of the bar (not the usual 2-and-4) with an extra turnaround hit in bar 2, and an off-beat open hat plus a percussion loop (the 'chord stab' slot) programmed exactly on syncopated 16ths. Pair the perc slot with slow filter automation and a long delay; this groove is deliberately sparse so the reverb tail has room to breathe. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
